defs.def: the number of years that a person has lived or a thing has existed 年龄

ex.s: She has two children aged eight and four.
ex.t: 她有两个孩子，一个八岁，一个四岁。

ex.s: Ages ago, right?
ex.t: 很久以前了吧？

ex.s: Children aged four to six at a nursery school were placed in a room.
ex.t: 一家幼儿园里四到六岁的孩子们被带到一个房间里。

ex.s: The school offers activities targeted at kids aged 3 to 13.
ex.t: 学校为3到13岁的孩子提供针对性活动。

ex.s: The Socrates Express is a fun, sharp book that draws readers in with its apparent simplicity and gradually pulls them in deeper thoughts on desire, loneliness, and aging.
ex.t: 《苏格拉底快线》是一本有趣而犀利的书，以其表面的简单吸引读者，逐渐将他们带入对欲望、孤独和衰老的更深思考。

ex.s: •Full day camp for kids aged 5-13.
ex.t: •面向5-13岁儿童的全日营。

ex.t: 四周学习冲刺面向所有人开放，目标受众年龄在20至28岁之间。

ex.s: Salah Sukkarieh, a professor at the University of Sydney, sees robots as necessary given how cattlemen are aging.
ex.t: 悉尼大学教授萨拉赫·苏卡里赫认为，鉴于牧场主日益老龄化，机器人是必要的。

ex.s: At one school in the UK, children between the ages of 10 and 15 walk 6km with six litres of water.
ex.t: 在联合王国的一所学校,10至15岁的儿童步行6公里，有6升水。

ex.s: Something significant is happening to the world population it is aging.
ex.t: 世界人口正在发生一些重要的事情——它正在老龄化。

ex.s: The Chat Bench is a fantastic new project that   35   those of all ages to interact and get to know each other in the future.
ex.t: “聊天长椅”是一个很棒的新项目，它___35___各个年龄层的人在未来互动、相互了解。

ex.s: Who is eligible: Students aged 15-29, returning to school in the fall.
ex.t: 谁有资格：15至29岁的学生，秋季返校就读。

ex.s: We work with volunteers of all ages and backgrounds.
ex.t: 我们与各种年龄和背景的志愿者合作。

ex.s: Most of our volunteers are aged 17-24.Now we need volunteer managers aged 25-75.They are extremely important in the safe and effective running of our programmes.
ex.t: 我们的大多数志愿者年龄在17-24岁。现在我们需要25-75岁的志愿者经理。他们对我们计划的安全和有效运行极其重要。

ex.s: The friendship that grew out of the experience of making that film and The Sting four years later had its root in the fact that although there was an age difference, we both came from a tradition of theater and live TV.
ex.t: 从拍摄那部电影以及四年后拍摄《骗中骗》的经历中发展出来的友谊，其根源在于这样一个事实：尽管我们有年龄差距，但我们都来自戏剧和现场电视的传统。

ex.s: Benjamin West, the father of American painting, showed his talent for art when he was only six years of age.
ex.t: 本杰明·韦斯特，美国绘画之父，年仅六岁时就展现了他的艺术天赋。

ex.s: The friendship that grew out of the experience of making that film and The Sting four years later had its root in the fact that although there was an age difference, we both came from a tradition of theater and live TV.
ex.t: 从拍摄那部电影以及四年后拍摄《骗中骗》的经历中发展出来的友谊，其根源在于这样一个事实：尽管我们有年龄差距，但我们都来自戏剧和现场电视的传统。

ex.s: The report data shows that pleasure reading levels for younger children, ages 2-8, remain largely the same.
ex.t: 报告数据显示，2-8岁儿童的娱乐性阅读水平基本保持不变。

ex.s: A couple of years ago, film-maker David Bond realised that his children, then aged five and three, were attached to screens to the point where he was able to say "chocolate" into his three-year-old son’s ear without getting a response.
ex.t: 影片制作人大卫·邦德(David Bond)在几年前意识到，他的孩子当时五岁三岁，被贴在屏幕上，以至于他可以在三岁的儿子的耳朵里说"巧克力"而没有得到回应。

ex.s: Who is eligible: Students aged 16 or 17 at time of hire, but not turning 18 before December 31 this year.
ex.t: 谁有资格：聘用时年龄16或17岁，但在今年12月31日之前未满18岁。

ex.s: AGE, SKILLS, WHAT TO BRING
ex.t: 年龄、技能、需携带物品

ex.s: It's getting louder with age.
ex.t: 它随着年龄增长变得越来越大。

ex.s: “Age is just another bot- her attempting to convince you of the impossible in the world, but actually the world is filled with possibilities,” she once said.
ex.t: “年龄不过是另一个试图让你相信世界上不可能的事的bot-her，但实际上世界充满可能，”她曾说。

ex.s: Her notice included what kind of training she wanted to do, how many days a week and how many hours she wanted to spend on each session, and her age.
ex.t: 她的启事包括她想做哪种训练、每周几天、每次几小时，以及她的年龄。

ex.s: It had simple words and colorful pictures—a perfect match for his age.
ex.t: 它有简单的文字和彩色的图画——正适合他的年龄。

ex.s: Her inability to act her age.
ex.t: 她不能表现得符合她的年龄。

ex.s: Challenging work that requires lots of analytical thinking, planning and other managerial skills might help your brain stay sharp as you age, a study published Wednesday in the journal Neurology suggests.
ex.t: 周三发表在《神经学》期刊上的一项研究表明，需要大量分析思考、规划和其他管理技能的富有挑战性的工作，可能有助于你的大脑随着年龄增长保持敏锐。

ex.s: age is not a barrier to achieving one's goal
ex.t: B. 年龄不是实现目标的障碍

ex.s: How much sleep you need depends a lot on your age.
ex.t: 你需要的睡眠时间很大程度上取决于你的年龄。

ex.s: I remember when you were his age, you said that you wanted to be a professional football player.
ex.t: 我记得当你在他这个年纪的时候，你说过你想成为一名职业足球运动员。

ex.s: As we age, even if we're healthy, the heart just isn't as efficient in processing oxygen as it used to be.
ex.t: 随着年龄增长，即使我们身体健康，心脏在处理氧气时也不如从前那么高效了。

ex.s: They were of all ages and nationalities.
ex.t: 他们有各种年龄和国籍。

ex.s: What is the lower age limit for joining the Habitat Restoration Team?
ex.t: 加入栖息地修复小组的最低年龄限制是多少？

ex.s: They are of the same age.
ex.t: 他们年龄相同。

ex.s: The day is divided into two thematic sessions per age group.
ex.t: 每天按年龄组分两个主题时段。

ex.s: Campers enjoy a staff-to-child ratio ranging from 1:4 to 1:7 depending on the age group.
ex.t: 营员享受的员工与儿童比例在1:4到1:7之间，取决于年龄组。

ex.s: There are different levels of exercises for different age groups and we must do them according to our own health and age.
ex.t: 有针对不同年龄组的不同强度练习，我们必须根据自己的健康和年龄来做。

ex.s: Age isn't the only factor; I'd say it's also to do with the makeup of your household.
ex.t: 年龄不是唯一的因素；我想这与你的家庭成员构成也有关系。

ex.s: The median age of an American in 1950   56   （be） 30 -- today it is 41 and is expected   57   （increase） to 42 by 2050.
ex.t: 1950年美国人的年龄中位数___56___（be）30岁——今天是41岁，预计到2050年___57___（increase）到42岁。

ex.s: Cognitive Function May Decline As You Age
ex.t: 认知功能可能随年龄增长而衰退

ex.s: What is the age range required by Stewardship Youth Ranger Program?
ex.t: 资源管理员青年护林员项目要求的年龄范围是多少？

ex.s: In 1900, people died at the average age of 30.
ex.t: 1900年，人们的平均死亡年龄是30岁。

ex.s: Background information A triathlon is a sports competition in which people run, swim and cycle over various distances, depending on age and ability.
ex.t: 背景资料 A triathlon 是一个体育比赛，根据年龄和能力，人们在比赛中跑步，游泳和在不同的距离上循环。

defs.def: a particular period of a person's life 年龄段

ex.s: Libraries will often hold reading-group sessions targeted to various age groups.
ex.t: 图书馆经常会举办针对不同年龄段的阅读小组活动。

ex.s: The festival is a public event for Harvard and community members of all ages.
ex.t: 这个艺术节是面向哈佛及社区各年龄段成员的公共活动。

ex.s: It offers art courses for all ages.
ex.t: 它为各年龄段提供艺术课程。

ex.s: These projects are for family members of all ages:
ex.t: 这些项目适合所有年龄段的家庭成员：

ex.s: “I can’t imagine doing anything else with my life.” Bridges runs dance classes for all ages.
ex.t: “我无法想象在生活中做其他任何事情。”布里奇斯为所有年龄段的人开设舞蹈课。

ex.s: It tailors learning experiences to different age groups and learning styles.
ex.t: 它针对不同年龄段和学习风格量身定制学习体验。

ex.s: A big part of my mission is to get people of all ages off sugary drinks,” Tom explains.
ex.t: 我使命的重要部分是让各个年龄段的人远离含糖饮料，汤姆解释道。

ex.s: And, there are tasks for every age and ability, so all your children can feel proud of their work.
ex.t: 而且，每个年龄段和能力都有任务，所以你所有的孩子都能对自己的工作感到自豪。

defs.def: a particular period of history （历史上的）时代，时期

ex.s: Wang collected more than 7 million abandoned bricks of different ages.
ex.t: 王先生收集了700多万块不同时期的废弃砖块。

ex.s: Volunteers aged 10 and over are welcome.
ex.t: 欢迎10岁及以上的志愿者参加。

ex.s: Analyses of a language database also confirmed that there was a global change in the sound of world languages after the Neolithic age, with the use of “f” and “v” increasing remarkably during the last few thousand years.
ex.t: 对一个语言数据库的分析也证实，新石器时代之后世界语言的声音发生了全球性的变化，"f"和"v"的使用在近几千年显著增加。

ex.s: Under this Act, all waterfowl hunters 16 years of age and over must annually purchase and carry a Federal Duck Stamp.
ex.t: 根据该法案，所有16岁及以上的水禽猎人每年必须购买并携带一张联邦鸭票。

ex.s: Discover the China of“past ages，its walled cities，temples and mountain scenery with Prof  Robert Thorp.
ex.t: 与Robert Thorp教授一起发现"过去时代"的中国，它的城墙环绕的城市、寺庙和山地风光。

ex.s: "The sweet spot in life to start exercising, if you haven't already, is in late middle age when the heart still has flexibility," Levine says.
ex.t: "如果你还没有开始运动，生命中开始运动的最佳时期是中年晚期，这时心脏仍有弹性，"Levine说。

ex.s: Now that we are in the information age, we have new concepts such as the computer, information processing, virtual reality, and simulation.
ex.t: 既然我们处于信息时代，我们就有了计算机、信息处理、虚拟现实和模拟等新概念。

ex.s: In the Digital Age, we’re used to having what we need immediately and right ai our fingertips.
ex.t: 在数字时代，我们习惯了立刻就能得到满足，所需之物尽在指尖。

ex.s: We journalists live in a new age of storytelling, with many new multimedia tools.
ex.t: 我们记者生活在讲故事的新时代，拥有许多新的多媒体工具。

ex.s: What is Klein's understanding of the age of electricity?
ex.t: Klein对电力时代的理解是什么？

ex.s: It is closely linked to the steam age.
ex.t: 它与蒸汽时代密切相关。

ex.s: The age of pen-and-paper letter writing may have passed.
ex.t: 纸笔写信的时代可能已经过去了。

ex.s: Inglis said phone boxes called to mind an age when things were built to last.
ex.t: 英格利斯说，电话亭让人想起一个东西都做得经久耐用的时代。

ex.s: Researchers from the University of Leipzig in Germany gathered more than 1, 000 retired workers who were over age 75 and assessed the volunteers’ memory and thinking skills through a battery of tests.
ex.t: 德国莱比锡大学的研究人员召集了1000多名75岁以上的退休工人，通过一系列测试评估志愿者的记忆力和思维能力。

ex.s: Some 60,000 novels were published during the Victorian age, from 1837 to1901; today a casual reader might be able to name a half-dozen of them.
ex.t: 在维多利亚时代，从1837年到1901年，出版了约6万本小说；今天，一个随便的读者也许可以将其中的六分之一命名。

ex.s: The first is that antitrust authorities need to move from the industrial age into the 21st century.
ex.t: 第一个是反垄断机构需要从工业时代迈入21世纪。

ex.s: Restarting antitrust for the information age will not be easy.
ex.t: 为信息时代重启反垄断并非易事。

ex.s: Yet properly understood, the age of electricity is merely the second stage in the age of steam, which began a century earlier.
ex.t: 然而正确理解的话，电力时代仅仅是蒸汽时代的第二阶段，蒸汽时代开始于一个世纪前。

ex.s: The digital age also enables us to find people who share our interests, such as collecting model cars or playing an unusual instrument.
ex.t: 数字时代也使我们能够找到与我们有共同兴趣的人，例如收集模型汽车或演奏不寻常的乐器。

ex.s: We could also say In the digital age, we are able to find people who have the same interests as we do, such as collecting model cars or playing an unusual instrument.
ex.t: 我们还可以说，在数字时代，我们能够找到与我们有着相同兴趣的人，比如收集模范汽车或者演奏一种不寻常的乐器。

ex.s: Who is eligible: Students aged 15 or older.
ex.t: 谁有资格：15岁或以上的学生。

ex.s: As the generation to have grown up in the Information Age, they are quite confident when it comes to showing off their interests and skills in this field.
ex.t: 作为在信息时代长大的一代人，他们在展示自己在这一领域的兴趣和技能时相当自信。

defs.def: the state of being old 老年；陈年；破旧；老化

ex.s: The aging process of the heart.
ex.t: 心脏的老化过程。

ex.s: How can people be successful in old age according to the author’s grandmother? (no more than 10 words)

ex.t: 为老年人提供兼职工作。

defs.def: a very long time 很长时问

ex.s: It takes ages to see the results.
ex.t: 检查结果需要很长时间

ex.s: The concept of beauty today is very different from what it was in ancient Greece or the Middle Ages, and so are most of our “laws” of nature.
ex.t: 如今美的概念与古希腊或中世纪时的概念大不相同，我们大多数自然"定律"也是如此。

ex.s: “Tom built up a passion for environmental protection at a very early age," Matt added.
ex.t: “汤姆在很小的时候就培养了对环境保护的热情，”马特补充道。

ex.s: He learned the value and beauty of    22    there from a very young age.
ex.t: 他从小就在那里懂得了___22___的价值与美。

ex.s: What if the only way of getting news from far away friends was writing letters that took ages to be delivered?
ex.t: 如果从遥远的朋友那里获得消息的唯一方法是写信，而这些信件需要很长时间才能送达，那该怎么办？

defs.def: a length of time which is a division of an epoch 期

ex.t: Young 女士早年培养了对烹饪的热情。

ex.t: 从六岁起，现年26岁的特丽就在学校放假期间陪德里克去干活。

defs.def: when a person comes of age, they reach the age when they have an adult's legal rights and responsibilities 成年；达到法定年龄

ex.s: "There is a lot of really interesting evidence which seems to be suggesting that if children are inspired up to the age of seven, then being outdoors will be a habit for life." His own children have got into the habit of playing outside now: "We just send them out into the garden and tell them not to come back in for a while."
ex.t: “有大量非常有趣的证据似乎表明，如果孩子在七岁前受到启发，那么待在户外将成为一生的习惯。”他自己的孩子现在也养成了在外面玩的习惯：“我们只是把他们赶到花园里，告诉他们一会儿别回来。”

ex.s: They first met at the age of 20.

ex.s: Many students say they will talk to their friend or classmates because they're of the same age and can understand each other.
ex.t: 只有少数选择自己处理问题。

ex.t: 因为附近没有我这个年纪的孩子 我不得不一个人呆上几个小时

ex.t: 我们把2至4岁的幼童带到南加州大学的“心智发展实验室”。

defs.def: if sth comes of age, it reaches the stage of development at which people accept and value it 成熟；发达

ex.s: Psychologist Susan Levine, an expert on mathematics development in young children the University of Chicago, found children who play with puzzles between ages 2 and 4 later develop better spatial skills.
ex.t: 芝加哥大学儿童数学发展专家、心理学家苏珊·莱文发现，在2到4岁之间玩拼图的孩子，日后会发展出更好的空间技能。

ex.s: Children aged from 11 to 14.

defs.def: to make sb/sth look, feel or seem older 使显老；使变老；使苍老

ex.s: While the sun's rays can age and harm our skin, they also give us beneficial Vitamin D.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 虽然阳光会使我们的皮肤老化和受损，但它也给我们提供有益的维生素D。

defs.def: to develop in flavour over a period of time; to allow sth to do this （使）成熟，变陈

ex.s: Fortunately for those in midlife, Levine is finding that even if you haven't been an enthusiastic exerciser, getting in shape now may help improve your aging heart.
ex.t: 对那些中年人来说幸运的是，莱文发现，即使你一直不是热衷锻炼的人，现在开始健身也可能有助于改善你衰老的心脏。

ex.s: This aging of the population is driven   59   two factors.
ex.t: 人口的老龄化是由两个因素驱动的。

ex.s: All this fun is available for ages 9 to 18.
ex.t: 所有这些乐趣面向9至18岁。
